name: K-Type Thermocouple
description: K-type thermocouples are the most common thermocouple type and are frequently used in 3D printing for high-temperature applications. They consist of nickel-chromium and nickel-aluminium alloy wires and are capable of measuring temperatures from -200°C to 1350°C. Because thermocouples produce a very small voltage (approximately 41µV/°C), a dedicated amplifier such as the MAX31855 or MAX31856 is required to interface with a 3D printer control board. The Klipper sensor type depends on which amplifier board is used.

klipperSpecs.sensorType: MAX31855 or MAX31856 depending on amplifier
